notes.title: A Street Cat's Tale Patch Notes - 3/13/2020
notes.notes:
Hello everyone, this is CFK.

Nintendo Switch version of A Street Cat's Tale was released on March 12 (Thu) 2020.
We updated the STEAM version to match the Nintendo Switch version.

The details of the update are as follows:

Applied the new logo design
Added keyboard and gamepad control options
Added screen resolution change and full-screen mode options
Miscellaneous improvements on in-game features and stability

Thank you very much for purchasing A Street Cat's Tale,
and also for visiting the community hub with an interest in our game.

Our gratitude never stops. We will keep doing our best to meet your expectations.
